title: Riverbend Self-Pay Package Terms (Good Faith & Price Estimates)
content:
**Article 1 — All-inclusive price.** A Good Faith & Price Estimates package price is all-inclusive for the listed service code, and the estimate on a package type limits what the patient may be billed: the patient is billed the package price and nothing else for the package, except the package exclusions of the type, each billed at actual charges less the uninsured discount. An upgrade within the maternity package (cesarean delivery) adds the type's upgrade differential, and each overnight stay beyond the type's included overnight stays adds the type's additional-overnight amount.

**Article 2 — Deposit at scheduling.** The clause "at scheduling the patient pays a deposit of the deposit percentage of the package price, rounded half-up to the cent" is **no longer in force** as the handling basis for the initial deposit on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery estimate or the enrollment deposit on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery estimate. On every other package type the deposit paid at scheduling stays the type's deposit percentage of the package price, rounded half-up to the cent.

**Article 3 — Pre-service balance.** The clause "on types with balance-due days above zero, the rest of the package price is paid no later than that many calendar days before the scheduled service date as a pre-service balance deposit" is **no longer in force** as the handling basis for the pre-service balance on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery estimate or the pre-delivery balance on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery estimate. On every other package type with balance-due days above zero, the rest of the package price is paid no later than that many calendar days before the scheduled service date as a pre-service balance deposit.

**Article 4 — Payment methods.** Deposits are accepted through the deposit methods of the type.

**Article 5 — Billing a package service.** A package service is billed as a package price adjustment bringing the account's patient balance down to the package price, never through the uninsured discount.

**Article 6 — Non-package estimates.** Good faith estimates on non-package types are not binding prices; Riverbend bills actual charges less the uninsured discount, and the dispute process protects the patient against a large excess.

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- On the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Imaging & Diagnostics type, whose deposit percentage is 100 percent, a hypothetical package price of 1000.00 gives a deposit at scheduling of 1000.00.
- A maternity package patient delivered by cesarean and staying three nights is billed the package price plus the upgrade differential plus one additional overnight stay; a complication outside the package that is a listed exclusion is billed at actual charges less the uninsured discount.
